title.zh: 【Fhenix 全同态加密协处理器 CoFHE 上线主网】
title.en: 【Fhenix 全同态加密协处理器 CoFHE 上线主网】

current_state.zh: Fhenix launched its fully homomorphic encryption coprocessor CoFHE on mainnet for Ethereum and Arbitrum, initially as a permissioned partner network, alongside a Claude Code developer toolkit.
